subject.title: feat(ui): docs, help, Discord, and changelog links in the agent chip menu

question: Should the Control UI agent-chip menu permanently promote Help, Discord, and release notes alongside Docs?
rationale: This changes core product chrome, and the protected `maintainer` label means destination prominence and menu density require explicit owner intent beyond code correctness.

options.title: Keep all four links
options.body: Approve the proposed destination set after viewport behavior and browser proof are complete.

options.title: Keep support links only
options.body: Retain Docs and Help while removing Discord or release notes to reduce persistent menu density.

options.title: Leave Docs only
options.body: Preserve the current single-link utility menu and route the other destinations through existing documentation surfaces.

recommendation.title: Keep all four links
recommendation.body: Approve the proposed destination set after viewport behavior and browser proof are complete.

likelyOwner.reason: The current agent-chip menu originates in their merged feature commit, making them the clearest history-backed owner of its product shape.
